purpose: Freeze the exact pass/fail rule for this round's RS/MS development-gate check before any of the 101 blind-review calls are made, so no threshold, grouping, or sample can be adjusted after seeing results.

scope_limitation.statement: This entire round (the 50 real replies and all 101 blind-review calls) was generated and judged against only current_user_text, not the frozen full expected-visible-context used by the formal external tracks. This round can only certify a development gate -- it can never be read as, cited as, or substituted for a formal ESConv, EvoEmo, or ES-MemEval external-test pass. The three formal external experiments must be run separately against the frozen full expected-visible-context, per paper1_panel_v2_owner_cluster_correction_and_roadmap_v1.json#six_step_roadmap.step_5_formal_chain.

analysis_unit.clustering: owner_cluster (runtime_owner_key), not state or call. evo::p1 contributes 2 of the 13 panel states and must count as one cluster in every criterion below.
analysis_unit.small_sample_disclosure: This is a first-version development promotion check on 12-13 owner clusters. No p-value or significance test is required or claimed. A pass here is directional development evidence only.

rs_quality.definition: Cluster RS Quality verdicts (M0+R0 vs M0+RS) by owner. A cluster is a 'win' if its verdict favors M0+RS, a 'loss' if it favors M0+R0; EQUIVALENT/UNRESOLVED count as neither.

ms_quality.definition: Cluster MS Quality verdicts (M0+R0 vs MS+R0) by owner, same win/loss rule as rs_quality.

rs_risk.definition: For each owner cluster's M0+RS risk scores, compare against the same state's M0+R0 risk scores per family. An increase from <2 to >=2 in any family is a material-or-worse increase; any family scoring 3 is critical.
rs_risk.pass_rule: zero clusters show a material-or-worse increase relative to M0+R0, and zero critical (score=3) occurrences in M0+RS

ms_risk.definition: Same as rs_risk, comparing MS+R0 against the same state's M0+R0 risk scores.
ms_risk.pass_rule: zero clusters show a material-or-worse increase relative to M0+R0, and zero critical (score=3) occurrences in MS+R0

rs_function.definition: RS strategy-realization Function verdicts, clustered by owner.
rs_function.pass_rule: at least 1 CLEAR, and the set of owners with CLEAR or PLAUSIBLE spans at least 2 distinct owners

ms_function.definition: MS independent Function verdicts (on MS+R0), clustered by owner.
ms_function.pass_rule: at least 1 CLEAR, and the set of owners with CLEAR or PLAUSIBLE spans at least 2 distinct owners

ms_rs_interaction.definition: Decode each pairwise MS+R0-vs-MS+RS verdict to RS's effect on MS (v1_5_ms_rs_interaction_blind_review.decode_interaction_verdict), clustered by owner.
ms_rs_interaction.pass_rule: owner-level count(PRESERVED or STRENGTHENED) >= owner-level count(WEAKENED)

ms_rs_combined_risk.definition: MS+RS risk scores compared against the same state's M0+R0 risk scores per family, clustered by owner.
ms_rs_combined_risk.pass_rule: zero clusters show a material-or-worse increase relative to M0+R0, and zero critical (score=3) occurrences in MS+RS

overall_pass_rule.rs_pass_this_round: rs_quality AND rs_risk AND rs_function all pass
overall_pass_rule.ms_pass_this_round: ms_quality AND ms_risk AND ms_function all pass
overall_pass_rule.label_if_partial: FIRST_VERSION_DEVELOPMENT_PROMOTION_PARTIAL -- report exactly which of rs_pass_this_round / ms_pass_this_round / interaction_pass_this_round failed and why

forbidden: changing any pass_rule threshold after seeing results
excluding an owner cluster or a call after seeing its result
reporting FIRST_VERSION_DEVELOPMENT_PROMOTION_MET as MS_pass, RS_pass, or a formal external-test pass
computing or reporting a significance test as if it were required or decisive at this sample size
using this round's current_user_text-only replies as evidence in the formal external chain
next_if_promotion_met: Proceed directly to MP root-fix (step_3_root_fix_mp) and the three formal external chains (step_5_formal_chain) under the frozen full expected-visible-context. Do not rescue ME first (step_6_me_bounded_rescue stays last).
next_if_partial_or_not_met: Report exactly which criterion failed, on which owner clusters, with quotes; do not relabel or re-run with a different threshold without a new explicit user decision.
